rationale: The left node 'Mặt phẳng vuông góc với đường thẳng song song' is a theorem about planes perpendicular to a line being parallel. The right node 'Tính chất đường thẳng song song với mặt phẳng' is a theorem about a property when a line is parallel to a plane. They are distinct theorems about different geometric relationships (plane-line perpendicularity leading to parallelism vs. line-plane parallelism and intersection).
